description: This PHP source file defines the EmailAddressRelationship class, which manages a specialized many-to-many relationship for email addresses within the SuiteCRM project. It extends the M2MRelationship class and provides methods to add and remove email address relationships, with custom logic for handling left-hand side beans and relationship-specific behaviors.

classes.name: EmailAddressRelationship
classes.description: Represents a many-to-many relationship tailored for email addresses in SuiteCRM, with custom add and remove logic to handle the specifics of email address relationships.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new email address relationship between the left-hand side bean and the right-hand side bean, handling relationship loading and relationship table insertion.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an existing email address relationship between the left and right beans, with checks for bean types and relationship loading.

methods.name: getRoleWhere
methods.description: Generates an SQL where clause to check the relationship role, with additional handling for primary address role.
